turns.text: Let's see how I make it even better.
turns.zh: 咱们来看看我怎么把它改得更好。

turns.text: Well, I'm definitely an early bird.
turns.zh: 嗯，我绝对是个早起的人。

turns.text: I mean, I've always been an early riser, so I usually get up when the sun rises, without even setting my alarm clock.
turns.zh: 我是说，我一直都是早起型，所以通常太阳一出来我就起床了，连闹钟都不用设。

turns.text: Um, I just feel much more energetic and productive in the mornings, especially compared to the evenings when I feel drained and I just want to disconnect in front of the TV.
turns.zh: 嗯，我就是觉得早上精力充沛得多、效率也高得多，尤其是跟晚上比——晚上我累得不行，只想瘫在电视机前放空。

turns.text: Okay, so what makes the second one an even better answer?
turns.zh: 好，那第二个答案为什么更好呢？

turns.text: First of all, again, topic-specific vocabulary.
turns.zh: 首先，还是那句话，话题相关的词汇。

turns.text: Things like an early bird or an early riser, okay?
turns.zh: 比如 an early bird 或者 an early riser，对吧？

turns.text: "Setting my alarm clock." Notice when you're learning vocabulary to focus on the collocation, to set your alarm clock, right?
turns.zh: “Setting my alarm clock”。注意，学词汇的时候要关注搭配，是 set your alarm clock，对吧？
